propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache consumes 92% (~950 MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch, with only 55 MB of actual event data and bookkeeping fields that are never read.

The baseline_advanced_at timestamp and last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping fields are written frequently but read nowhere in src/, causing scattered edits that defeat git delta compression and inflict 12.79 KB marginal cost per version.
Deleting baseline_advanced_at reduces marginal cost 7.4x to 1.74 KB; moving last_get_pass to a sidecar file halves the version count for a 12.8x total compression gain.
A one-time git fast-export/filter/fast-import pipeline can reduce the pre-existing branch history from 1.17 GB to 99 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and byte-identical HEAD tree.
The reconciler runs on ephemeral runners so durable state must remain in git; cache content and churn must be reduced in-place rather than relocated off-branch.
